answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mesa is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
